nativeFailures.policy: All runtime-loaded indexed vertices and triangles use the exact before/after viewer terrain samplers. No newly wholly buried triangle is allowed. A terrain-distant component also requires >=50% of its native low rim to lie inside a lower same-parent or explicit CSUID-pinned installed native dependency.
